algorithm: Hungarian maximum gated cardinality, then minimum distance
distance: Euclidean distance of dimension-normalized parameter vectors
normalization: x/width, y/height; radius/diagonal; arc angles/360; mark extents/width,height
symmetry: segment and line endpoints reversible; all other parameter order retained
calibration: uncalibrated engineering fixture threshold; no G1 claim
ambiguity: row or column distance ties within 1e-12 remain unmatched; no label tie-breaking
